### Architectural & Technical Description

#### Scope of Work
This division encompasses the complete supply and installation of interior partition framing systems for the Boot Barn tenant fit-out at Turnpike Mall, Store #579. The scope is limited to non-load-bearing metal stud partition assemblies, associated floor and ceiling tracks, blocking, fire-stopping, and miscellaneous connectors. Based on the calculation summary, the total partition wall area (stud face) is **3,528 SF**, verified via plan layout and dimension chains from chunk 1 architectural sheets. Explicitly excluded from this scope are exterior wall framing (existing masonry demising walls remain), structural beams (existing structure, not shown), and structural columns (existing columns to remain per D10 demo plan). Line items FR.03, FR.04, FR.05, FR.06, FR.07, FR.10, and FR.11 carry zero quantities, confirming no wood studs, LVL beams, or structural steel are within this fit-out scope.

#### Materials & Finishes
The primary partition material is **3-5/8" 20ga metal studs (non-load-bearing)** covering 3,096 SF at a unit material cost of $1.05/SF and unit labor of $2.10/SF, yielding a total cost of $10,728.90 with 10% wastage (3,406 SF adjusted quantity). Wet-wall areas at restrooms utilize **6" 20ga metal studs (non-LB)** totaling 432 SF at $1.25/SF material and $2.25/SF labor, for $1,662.50. Metal track (floor & ceiling) per CSI 09 22 16 spans 784 LF at $0.55/LF material and $0.65/LF labor (5% wastage, 823 LF), totaling $987.60. All studs assume a partition height of 9'-0" per the assumptions, with sales area open to deck. Standard steel gauge conforms to ASTM C645 for non-structural members.

#### Installation & Application
Metal studs shall be installed at 16" o.c. spacing, seated into continuous floor and ceiling runner tracks, plumbed and aligned within industry tolerance of 1/8" in 10 feet. Blocking & fire-stopping per FR.09 covers the full 3,528 SF partition footprint at $0.45/SF material and $0.90/SF labor (10% wastage, 3,881 SF), totaling $5,239.35, providing backing for wall-mounted fixtures and firestop continuity at rated assemblies. Joist hangers & connectors (FR.12, CSI 06 05 23) are carried as an allowance across 3,528 SF at $0.25/SF material and $0.15/SF labor (5% wastage, 3,704 SF), totaling $1,481.60. Coordination with Division 26 electrical rough-in and Division 09 drywall is required to sequence in-wall utilities prior to board installation.

#### Surface Preparation
Substrate preparation includes verification of level floor slab conditions prior to track anchorage, mechanical fastening of runner tracks to concrete slab and structural deck above using power-actuated fasteners at maximum 24" o.c. Field verification of new versus existing walls per D10 demo plan is required, along with confirmation of framing gauge and spacing per structural notes. All penetrations shall be firestopped in accordance with UL-listed systems.

#### Drawings & Notes Reference
Quantities derive from A10 Floor Plan at 3/32" = 1'-0" scale, with a 15% wall deduction applied for doors and openings. The division subtotal is **$20,099.45**. Field verification items include confirming partition linear footage against A10 dimension strings at full scale. All framing quantities were derived solely from chunk 1 architectural sheets.

### Architectural & Technical Description

#### Scope of Work
This division covers the complete supply and installation of gypsum board wall and ceiling assemblies, cement board wet-area sheathing, taping and finishing, corner protection, and fasteners for the Boot Barn tenant fit-out. The calculation summary establishes a total wall face area (both sides) of **6,000 SF**, total ceiling drywall area of **620 SF** (limited to restrooms/office hard-lid construction, with the sales area open to deck), wet/fire-rated cement board area of **480 SF** at restroom walls, and total corner bead of **640 LF**. Painting (Division 09 Finishes) is explicitly out of scope, and this trade coordinates board installation over the Division 05/06 metal stud framing.

#### Materials & Finishes
The primary board is **1/2" standard gypsum wallboard** for walls (D.01), covering 5,520 SF at $0.38/SF material and $0.95/SF labor, totaling $8,075.76 with 10% wastage (6,072 SF adjusted). **1/2" ceiling drywall** (D.03) covers 620 SF at $0.40/SF material and $1.10/SF labor, totaling $1,023.00. **Cement board for wet areas** (D.04, CSI 09 21 16) covers 480 SF at $0.85/SF material and $1.25/SF labor, totaling $1,108.80, installed at restroom wet walls in conformance with ANSI A118.9 for tile substrate. Type-X fire-rated 5/8" board (D.02), Level 5 finish (D.06), and shaft wall assembly (D.09) all carry zero quantities and cost, indicating no rated or shaft conditions within this scope. Corner bead (D.07) is metal, 640 LF at $0.18/LF material and $0.35/LF labor (5% wastage, 672 LF), totaling $356.16.

#### Installation & Application
Gypsum board shall be installed vertically or horizontally over metal studs with screws at 12" o.c. in the field and 8" o.c. at edges. **Taping & Finishing — Level 4** (D.05, CSI 09 29 00) is applied across 6,140 SF at $0.22/SF material and $0.78/SF labor (5% wastage, 6,447 SF), totaling $6,447.00, and applies throughout per the assumptions. Level 4 finish comprises embedded tape with three coats of joint compound over joints, fasteners, and accessories, sanded smooth for standard eggshell or flat paint applications. Fasteners & screws (D.08) are carried as an allowance across 6,620 SF at $0.05/SF material, totaling $347.55 with no separate labor line. Coordination with electrical rough-in per Division 26 and framing per Division 05/06 is essential before board closure.

#### Surface Preparation
Substrate preparation includes verification of stud alignment and plumb, installation of moisture-resistant cement board backing in wet restroom locations, and priming/sealing surfaces prior to subsequent finish application by others. Joints shall be feathered and sanded to eliminate ridges and tool marks in accordance with GA-214 Level 4 criteria. Moisture control at wet walls is achieved through cement board with appropriate vapor management.

#### Drawings & Notes Reference
Quantities are derived from A10 Floor Plan (3/32" = 1'-0") and A20 RCP, with ceiling drywall limited to hard-lid rooms per assumptions. The division subtotal is **$17,358.27**. Wall deductions of 15% for doors/openings were applied at framing and carried through to board quantities. All drywall quantities were derived solely from chunk 1 architectural sheets.

### Architectural & Technical Description

#### Scope of Work
This division covers the supply and installation of interior electrical devices, LED lighting, life-safety devices, branch conduit and wire, and one electrical distribution panel for the Boot Barn tenant fit-out. The merged device summary reconciles counts from chunk 1 (A20/A01 architectural) and chunk 2 (E-series MEP): 56 duplex outlets, 10 GFCI outlets, 22 light switches/occupancy sensors, 225 LED recessed lights, 6 exit signs (verified once across chunks), 8 smoke detectors, 6 data outlets, and panel provisions. Panel "MP" 400A is explicitly excluded (no cost database line — field verify), while Panel "PP" 200A is priced. Fire suppression, low-voltage beyond basic data, and track lighting fixture supply (vendor/OFCI) are excluded.

#### Materials & Finishes
**Duplex outlets (120V)** (5.01, CSI 26 27 26) total 56 EA at $8.00 material and $45.00 labor each (5% wastage, 59 EA), totaling $3,127.00, mounted at standard 18" A.F.F. **GFCI outlets** (5.02) total 10 EA at $22.00 material and $55.00 labor (11 EA), totaling $847.00, located in wet and code-required areas. **Single-pole light switches** (5.03) total 22 EA at $5.00 material and $35.00 labor (23 EA), totaling $920.00, mounted at 44" A.F.F. **LED recessed lights (6")** (5.04, CSI 26 51 13) represent the largest device line at 225 EA at $35.00 material and $85.00 labor (5% wastage, 237 EA), totaling $28,440.00. **Exit signs (LED)** (5.05, CSI 26 52 13) total 6 EA at $85.00 material and $95.00 labor (7 EA), totaling $1,260.00. **Hardwired smoke detectors** (5.06, CSI 26 28 13) total 8 EA at $65.00 material and $95.00 labor (9 EA), totaling $1,440.00, including duct smoke detectors verified on M10/E10.

#### Installation & Application
**Conduit & Wire (Allowance)** (5.07, CSI 26 05 26) is applied over a single verified GFA of 17,137 SF at $6.00/SF material and $10.00/SF labor (10% wastage, 18,851 SF), totaling $301,616.00 — the dominant cost line. This allowance uses the M00 HVAC load calc GFA and supersedes the chunk 1 estimate of 17,692 SF to avoid double-counting the same floor area. The **200A electrical panel "PP"** (5.08, CSI 26 24 16) is 1 EA at $925.00 material and $985.00 labor (0% wastage), totaling $1,910.00. All branch wiring shall be installed in EMT conduit with THHN/THWN copper conductors sized per NEC, with device rough-in coordinated with framing prior to drywall closure.

#### Surface Preparation & Coordination
Rough-in boxes shall be set plumb and flush with finished wall surfaces, with mud rings sized to board thickness. All device/outlet counts require field verification as E10/E20 symbols were only partially legible and must reconcile with the final device schedule. The LED recessed versus track fixture split must be reconciled with the E30 fixture schedule (Type A pendant track 333 EA, C1 track heads 163 EA). Panel "MP" 400A pricing requires a separate quote.

#### Drawings & Notes Reference
Power/lighting drawn at 3/16" = 1'-0" per E10/E20/E30/E40. Occupancy is Mercantile (M) with 254 total occupants per T00 code review. The division subtotal is **$339,560.00**. Electrical costs are preliminary allowances pending E-series device schedule reconciliation. Sales area and stockroom are open to deck per A30.

### Architectural & Technical Description

#### Scope of Work
The Financial Summary consolidates the priced divisions of the Boot Barn Turnpike Mall Store #579 tenant fit-out into a single project cost rollup, along with applied markups for insurance, contingency, and overhead & profit. This estimate reflects the selected scopes only: Division 05/06 Framing, Division 09 Drywall, and Division 26 Electrical. All remaining divisions are designated "Not in Scope," reflecting the limited multi-trade nature of this fit-out where masonry demising walls, roofing, insulation, siding, windows, doors, painting, flooring, plumbing, and HVAC are excluded from the priced work.

#### Materials & Finishes / Cost Composition
The three active divisions carry the following subtotals: **Division 05/06 Framing at $20,099.45**, encompassing metal stud partitions, track, blocking, fire-stopping, and connectors; **Division 09 Drywall at $17,358.27**, encompassing gypsum board, cement board, taping, corner bead, and fasteners; and **Division 26 Electrical at $339,560.00**, which is by far the dominant division driven by the $301,616.00 conduit and wire allowance over 17,137 SF of gross floor area. General Requirements (Division 01) is carried at $0.00. The combined **SUBTOTAL is $377,017.72**.

#### Markups & Application
Markups are applied on the subtotal as follows: **Insurance at 5% ($18,850.89)** covering general liability and builder's risk provisions; **Contingency at 5% ($18,850.89)** reserved for unforeseen conditions, field verification adjustments, and reconciliation of preliminary electrical allowances; and **Overhead & Profit at 20% ($75,403.54)** covering the contractor's general conditions, supervision, and margin. The cumulative markups total $113,105.32 against the base subtotal, resulting in a **PROJECT TOTAL of $490,123.04**.

#### Coordination & Assumptions
The electrical division represents approximately 90% of the priced base subtotal, reflecting both the extensive LED recessed lighting count (225 EA) and the comprehensive conduit and wire allowance. Because these electrical costs are preliminary allowances pending E-series device schedule reconciliation, the contingency line is particularly relevant to the accuracy of the project total. The Panel "MP" 400A remains excluded pending a separate quote and would represent an addition to this total once priced.

#### Drawings & Notes Reference
This merged estimate combines chunk 1 (architectural) and chunk 2 (MEP) of the full drawing set, with framing and drywall quantities derived solely from chunk 1 architectural sheets and electrical device counts merged across both chunks. The estimate is valid for 30 days from the June 13, 2024 date of issue, priced on current market conditions for single-shift, normal working hours. All values are preserved exactly as issued, with the framing subtotal ($20,099.45), drywall subtotal ($17,358.27), and electrical subtotal ($339,560.00) reconciling to the stated subtotal of $377,017.72 and final project total of $490,123.04.
